name: asc-screenshot-resize
activation: `command -v asc` succeeds, `asc auth status --validate` passes, and the user confirms a paid Apple Developer Program account.
prerequisites: sips, built into macOS, for checks and resizing.
Uploading needs a paid Apple Developer Program account and asc with an App Store Connect API key.
risks: The batch alpha strip (SKILL.md:68-75) round-trips through JPEG and overwrites the originals; work on copies.
errata: SKILL.md:119 names the profile 'sRGB IEC61966-2.1.icc'; where /System/Library/ColorSync/Profiles lacks it, use 'sRGB Profile.icc' from the same folder.
